catalog: Recorded Jenkins UI screenshots for the public case study
capture_environment: Local Jenkins 2.580.2 at the loopback harness, Google Chrome headless

images.alt: Jenkins multibranch branch list for petclinic-pr. Main, fixed and docs-only show green success; the PMD and small-untested feature branches show red failure.
images.caption: Branch discovery and recorded outcomes. The two red branches are the controlled negative scenarios.

images.alt: Jenkins coverage overview for the small untested change build 11, showing project line coverage of 92.33 percent with the line bar in green.
images.caption: Project line coverage passes at 92.33 percent on the untested-change build.

images.alt: Jenkins modified-lines coverage tab for the same build, showing CoverageGap.java at 0.00 percent line coverage.
images.caption: The same build fails modified-lines coverage at 0.00 percent on the new production lines.

images.alt: Jenkins PMD package summary for the PMD violation build 13, showing two total findings and exactly one new finding in the petclinic package.
images.caption: Exactly one new PMD finding in the application package, against the clean main reference.

images.alt: Train-Ticket console for incremental build 11 showing the selector decision: modules mode, ts-order-service, upstream and downstream expansion enabled, and the changed path.
